notes: Sepolia project launch. Guest has a zero-argument constructor that mints its entire fixed supply to its deployer, with 18 decimals and no mint backdoor. Guestbook takes only the Guest token address via $token. Posting a message of at most 140 bytes transfers exactly one GUEST from the author to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD; this does not reduce ERC-20 total supply. Entries store author, timestamp and message, are enumerable by index, and cannot be edited. Neither contract has an owner, admin, upgrade path or additional fee. Posting uses checks-effects-interactions and a reentrancy guard; failed payments revert the entry and event. Durable token changes and successful posts emit events. The pool pairs with native ETH and has no hook; its initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96, not a promised valuation. Final independent review of the accepted source, bytecode and this manifest is required before deployment. Contributors never broadcast; the admitted release goes through the authorized deployer.
